title: "Starting a research notebook"
description: "What this section is for."
date: 2026-09-26
categories: [site]
---

This section will collect short notes: interesting documents turned up in archives, bibliographic finds, and work in progress on futurology, the New Left and postwar conservatism.

To add a note, create a new folder under `notes/` named with the date and a short slug, and put an `index.qmd` inside it.
